content.title: ArcelorMittal Secures Long-Term Low-Carbon Power Supply From EDF
content.summary: MT signs an 18-year nuclear power deal with EDF, locking in long-term low-carbon electricity for its sites in France starting Jan. 1, 2026.

content.title: Ingevity Completes Divestiture of CTO Refinery Assets to Mainstream
content.summary: NGVT completes a $110M all-cash sale of its North Charleston CTO refinery assets to streamline operations and focus on higher-margin specialties.

content.title: Element Solutions Acquires EFC, Adds to its High-Value Portfolio
content.summary: ESI completes EFC acquisition, expanding specialty and rare gases and advanced materials to target high-value markets and mid-single-digit growth.

content.title: PKX Advances LFP Cathode Materials Business With New JV
content.summary: POSCO Holdings advances its LFP cathode push with a CNGR-FINO JV, approving a Pohang plant set for 2026 build, 2027 output and 50,000-ton capacity.

content.title: Here's Why You Should Retain Carpenter Technology Stock for Now
content.summary: CRS rides strong Aerospace and Defense demand, robust bookings and backlog, with management eyeing $660-$700M fiscal 2026 operating income.

content.title: What's Behind Ingevity's 27% Rally in the Past 6 Months?
content.summary: NGVT shares surge 27% in six months, fueled by value-creating acquisitions, portfolio optimization and long-term growth initiatives.

content.title: All You Need to Know About Harmony Gold (HMY) Rating Upgrade to Buy
content.summary: Harmony Gold (HMY) might move higher on growing optimism about its earnings prospects, which is reflected by its upgrade to a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy).

content.title: Gold, Silver Stocks Dominate Elite List Of Growth Names With Metals Prices Set For Banner Year
content.summary: A large number of precious metals names are on the IBD 50 list of growth stocks as gold, silver, and copper prices hit record highs in 2025.

content.title: WLK to Cease Operations at Select Facilities Amid Challenges
content.summary: WLK plans to shut select North American chlorovinyl and styrene facilities by December 2025 amid prolonged global chemical market challenges.

content.title: BASFY Inks MoU to Develop Sustainable Footwear Solutions
content.summary: BASFY teams up with San Fang and Nichetech to launch GRS-certified TPU films, aiming to scale circular, low-carbon materials across global footwear supply chains.
